root_cause: No execution feedback: literal/join mismatches and projection ambiguity ship unverified SQL
what: Add a verify-and-repair loop: execute the draft query with env.execute; if it errors or returns 0 rows, make one repair call that includes the error/empty result plus small value samples from the tables referenced in the draft (so string literals can be matched to real stored values). Also add prompt rules for exact column projection ('which countries' -> country columns, not just names), anti-join NULL safety, and hint/value fidelity.
decision: s1 raises evolve score from 83.33 to 90.0 with two fixes and zero regressions, and its verify-and-repair loop plus value sampling is a general text-to-SQL mechanism rather than task-specific patching; the ~2x token increase is justified by the accuracy gain and bounded single repair call.

root_cause: Single-shot generation is never executed or value-checked: empty results from case-sensitive equality on padded/case-varied text and wrong literal columns pass through unverified
what: Add an execute-and-repair loop (2nd policy call only when the draft errors or returns 0 rows) that feeds back real DB diagnostics: for each string literal in the WHERE clause it probes actual stored values with a trimmed case-insensitive LIKE and shows them, so the model can fix 'Korea ' padding, 'Bachelors' vs stored degree name, cartoon title casing. Also add prompt rules to select all columns of the target entity for vague 'which X / details' questions and to treat both sides of symmetric relation tables as participants.

root_cause: Repair loop only sees the draft's own tables and never inspects stored values or alternative projections, so literal mismatches (sp0536), wrong projection width (sp0755) and empty NOT IN results (sp0894) survive the second call
what: Extend the existing verify-and-repair step: on error/empty results also sample rows from schema tables not referenced by the draft (exposing correct join/filter columns), probe actual stored values for each string literal via generic LIKE queries, and include a mechanical SELECT * variant of the draft as an alternative candidate; strengthen prompt guidance to prefer entity full rows and NOT EXISTS over NOT IN. All logic is schema-driven and generic.

root_cause: Literal/value mismatches are only diagnosed from head-of-table samples, so the repair call never sees the actual stored variants of the filtered column and re-emits the same non-matching literal
what: Extend the existing repair step with schema-driven value diagnostics: for every string literal compared in the draft (and tokens from question/hint), probe DISTINCT stored values of text columns in referenced tables that share a token or fuzzy-match the literal, plus a compact per-column value profile.
